entities.text: High Court Of Delhi At New Delhi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Petitioners
 Through: Mr. Ayaz Ahmed, Adv.
 versus
The State Gnct Of Delhi & Anr.

.....  Respondents  Through: Mr. Pradeep Gahalot, APP for the  State and SI Ajay, PS Neb Sarai  Mr. Subhash Chand & Mr. Suresh  Chand, Advs. for R-2  CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANISH DAYAL  ORDER % 23.03.2023
1. Exemption allowed subject to all just exceptions.

1. This petition has been filed seeking quashing for FIR No.327/2019 under sections 498A/406/34 IPC, P.S. Neb Sarai on the basis of settlement arrived at between the parties vide settlement dated 20th January, 2023 with the facilitation of Mediation Centre, Saket Courts Delhi which is on record of this Court.

2. Petitioner nos. 1 to 5 are present and have been duly identified by the IO and the counsel.
3.
Learned counsel for the respondent no.2-complainant however requests for accommodation by stating that the complainant is not available today as she is out of town.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that as per the settlement, a balance sum of Rs.6 lacs is to be paid to the respondent no.2 which the petitioner no.1 is ready to pay.
5.
Accordingly, list on 1st May, 2023 on which date both the petitioner no.1 and respondent no.2 shall remain personally present in the Court order to achieve culmination of quashing proceedings.
6. Appearance of petitioner nos. 2 to 5, who are family members of petitioner no.1, is exempted for the next date, on oral request the learned counsel.
